text:
jess: spotted plaintext DB URL in partner chart upload to staging: gs://redwood-staging-charts/partner-alpha/0.3.4/values.yaml -> DATABASE_URL=postgresql://svc_ingest:topsecret@staging-db:5432/ingest

omar: path noted. Did partner push via CI or manual?

jess: partner pushed with partner-ci SA, bypassed our ingest pipeline. Copied file to gs://sec-evidence/SEC-2026-900/values.yaml and removed public ACL.

kevin: Triage: staging-only unless audit shows external access. Plan: (1) remove partner SA write, (2) rotate DB user, (3) snapshot audits, (4) scan Vault for wrapped blobs referencing transit key.

oncall: removing roles/storage.objectCreator from partner-ci@partner at gs://redwood-staging-charts/* now.

devops-bot: IAM change applied by oncall at 3247802490.

omar: Running log search for svc_ingest usage: `gcloud logging read 'textPayload:"svc_ingest"' --limit=200`

kevin: Rotate: use infra script, write new creds to Vault at secret/data/staging/db/svc_ingest_rot2, mark old as deprecated.

jess: Snapshot audits before any rewrap: `gcloud logging read 'logName="projects/redwood/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access"' --format=json > /tmp/audit.json`

omar: Found wrapped blob entries under secret/partner-alpha/* referencing transit-key-v1. We'll rewrap using a rewrap-temp KMS key and the rewrap tool.

kevin: Canary via ConfigSync to 1 pod. Rollback threshold: >5% auth failures in 10m.

devops-bot: Canary rollout triggered at 3247802535.

jess: Canary success, monitoring 15m. No external IPs seen in audit. Proceed to revoke old creds and run rewrap.

security-bot: SEC-2026-900 created and closed at 3247802580. Closure note: staging-only leak; creds rotated; RBAC and pipeline mitigations queued.
